lines.en: label harukadate15:
I tap on Haruka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Haruka 的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: We talked recently about spending some time together at her place and watching movies or something along those lines, so I figure now is as good a time as any to make that dream a reality.
lines.zh: 我们最近聊过去她家一起待一会儿、看看电影什么的，所以我觉得现在就是把这个梦想变成现实的好时机。

lines.en: And when I say “dream,” I mean it very loosely as my dreams are much more exciting.
lines.zh: 不过我说“梦想”这个词，用得非常宽松——因为我真正做的梦可比这刺激多了。

lines.en: When I actually have them, that is.
lines.zh: 前提是我还真做得着梦的话。

lines.en: Lately, I haven’t been having-
lines.zh: 最近我一直都没怎么——

lines.en: : Hey! What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿！怎么啦？

lines.en: : Oh, hey. Nothing really.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。也没什么事。

lines.en: : Are you free tonight?
lines.zh: : 你今晚有空吗？

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I am. Sara just bailed on me and Molly is “managing” the cafe tonight.
lines.zh: : 还真有空。Sara 刚放了我鸽子，Molly 今晚在“代管”咖啡馆。

lines.en: : And you’re sure the cafe is going to be okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定咖啡馆不会出事？

lines.en: : Nope! But I really don’t want to think about work right now.
lines.zh: : 完全不确定！不过我现在真的不想去想工作。

lines.en: : Come over and let’s do stuff.
lines.zh: : 过来吧，我们做点什么。

lines.en: : I’d offer to pick you up but I’m feeling really lazy and don’t want to leave right now.
lines.zh: : 我本来想说去接你，可我现在懒得要命，不想出门。

lines.en: : Wow. Thank you for the kind offer, but I will walk.
lines.zh: : 哇。多谢你好意，不过我走着去。

lines.en: : I know you will!
lines.zh: : 我就知道！

lines.en: : See you soon!
lines.zh: : 待会儿见！

lines.en: Haruka hangs up the phone and, before I know it, I’m walking to her place.
lines.zh: Haruka 挂了电话，等我反应过来，人已经在往她家走了。

lines.en: scene nightsky
The walk to Haruka’s is always kind of annoying.
lines.zh: 走去 Haruka 家这一路，总是有点烦人。

lines.en: I should probably invest in a car sooner or later, but...
lines.zh: 我早晚该买辆车，可是……

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 说不好。

lines.en: I’ve gotten kind of familiar with these streets over my time here.
lines.zh: 在这儿待了这么久，我对这些街道已经有点熟了。

lines.en: I’m memorizing them quicker than I’ve memorized anything, I think.
lines.zh: 我觉得，我记住它们的速度，比我记过的任何东西都快。

lines.en: Besides things that are meant to be memorized like phone numbers or addresses.
lines.zh: 当然，除了电话号码、地址这类本来就该记住的东西。

lines.en: You know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: 你懂我什么意思。

lines.en: The process of remembering things that you are only kind of supposed to remember.
lines.zh: 就是那种“本来只是顺便记住”的东西。

lines.en: Like streets or the names of distant relatives.
lines.zh: 比如街道，或者远房亲戚的名字。

lines.en: Like how many beeps the microwave makes after it finishes blasting radiation into a frozen TV dinner.
lines.zh: 比如微波炉把冷冻电视晚餐轰完辐射之后会响几声。

lines.en: These are things we memorize subconsciously as opposed to consciously.
lines.zh: 这些东西我们是下意识记住的，而不是刻意去记的。

lines.en: But the more time I spend here, the more I move from the former form of memorization to the latter.
lines.zh: 但我在这儿待得越久，就越是从前者转向后者。

lines.en: I want to memorize these streets.
lines.zh: 我想把这些街道记住。

lines.en: I feel I’ll be spending a concerning amount of time traversing them if nothing goes horribly wrong in the near future.
lines.zh: 我有种预感，要是近期不出什么大乱子，我会在这上面花掉多得吓人的时间。

lines.en: I arrive at Haruka’s place after what seems like half an hour and ring the bell.
lines.zh: 感觉像是过了半小时，我到了 Haruka 家，按响了门铃。

lines.en: scene black
: Hey! How was your walk?
lines.zh: : 嘿！走过来还顺利吗？

lines.en: : Unnecessary.
lines.zh: : 多余。

lines.en: scene harukaalone1
: Well, on the bright side, you get to see me now. So that’s at least slightly rewarding, right?
lines.zh: : 往好处想，你现在能见到我了。所以至少算是有点回报，对吧？

lines.en: : Slightly, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点吧，嗯。

lines.en: : Awesome. I’m almost worth a thirty minute walk.
lines.zh: : 太好了。我差不多值这三十分钟的路。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say this is personally better than I ever thought I’d do, sooooo hooray for Haruka!
lines.zh: : 我得说，这成绩可比我以前以为的好多了，所——以——为 Haruka 欢呼！

lines.en: : I’ve only been here for ten seconds and the self-esteem issues are already coming out.
lines.zh: : 我才来了十秒钟，自尊心问题就开始往外冒了。

lines.en: : Tonight is going to be a blast.
lines.zh: : 今晚一定精彩极了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone2
: Hey, you knew what you were signing up for and you still came either way.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你知道自己签的是什么卖身契，可你还是来了。

lines.en: : I even gave you the chance to say “No, I don’t want to walk all the way over there,” and yet, here you are.
lines.zh: : 我甚至给了你机会说“不，我不想走那么远过去”，结果呢，你还是来了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone3
: So, since you’re here, I guess it’s finally time we find something to do, huh?
lines.zh: : 既然你都来了，我想我们总该找点事做了吧？

lines.en: : What would the gameplan have been if I never came?
lines.zh: : 要是我没来，你的计划会是什么？

lines.en: : I told you at the cafe, didn’t I? Probably ice cream and crying.
lines.zh: : 我在咖啡馆不是说过了吗？大概是吃冰淇淋加哭。

lines.en: : You can still eat ice cream if you want.
lines.zh: : 你要是想吃冰淇淋，现在也可以吃。

lines.en: scene harukaalone1
: I’d have to run out and buy some.
lines.zh: : 那我还得跑出去买。

lines.en: : Want me to cry instead?
lines.zh: : 要不我改成哭？

lines.en: : Not really. I never know what to do around girls when they cry.
lines.zh: : 还是别了。女孩一哭，我永远不知道该拿她们怎么办。

lines.en: scene harukaalone4
: Uhh, how often are you around crying girls?
lines.zh: : 呃，你身边经常有哭的女孩吗？

lines.en: : Often enough for this to be an actual thing I have learned about myself.
lines.zh: : 经常到足以让我把它当成一条关于自己的确切认知。

lines.en: : Fair enough. What you do on your own time isn’t really my business.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。你私底下干什么，确实不关我的事。

lines.en: scene harukaalone5
: Know what is my business, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你知道什么才是我的事吗？

lines.en: : What, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 什么，Haruka？

lines.en: : Koi Cafe.
lines.zh: : Koi Cafe。

lines.en: : Get it?
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？

lines.en: : Cause like-
lines.zh: : 因为吧——

lines.en: : Yeah.
lines.zh: : 算了。

lines.en: : Okay, well it’s been fun. I’ll see you later.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这段时间很开心。回见了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone6
: Oh, come on! That was good!
lines.zh: : 哦拜托！那个挺好的啊！

lines.en: : Here, come sit down. It’s no fun just standing near the door and listening to me tell jokes.
lines.zh: : 来，过来坐。光站在门口听我讲冷笑话，一点意思都没有。

lines.en: Well, she’s right about that, at the very least.
lines.zh: 至少这一点上，她说得没错。

lines.en: scene black
Haruka walks over to her sofa, grabbing the TV remote off the table in front of her and turning up the volume on whatever program she was watching before I got here.
lines.zh: Haruka 走到沙发边，抓起面前桌上的电视遥控器，把我来之前正在看的那个节目的音量调大。

lines.en: I walk back to the entryway and kick my shoes off after I realize I forgot to remove them before taking my place next to her on the couch.
lines.zh: 我走回玄关把鞋踢掉——这才想起来，在沙发上挨着她坐下之前，我忘了脱鞋。

lines.en: scene harukaalone7
: So, welcome to a day in the life of me.
lines.zh: : 那么，欢迎来到“我的一天”。

lines.en: : When I’m not making cappuccinos or bossing around a bunch of mini versions of myself, I’m doing this.
lines.zh: : 我不做卡布奇诺、也不指挥一群缩小版的自己的时候，就在干这个。

lines.en: : Sitting on a couch and contemplating what sort of person I am while watching Gordon Ramsay make children feel bad about themselves on Master Chef Junior.
lines.zh: : 坐在沙发上，一边看戈登·拉姆齐在《小小厨神》里把小孩子们说得无地自容，一边思考自己到底是个什么样的人。

lines.en: : You lead an interesting life, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 你的生活真有意思，Haruka。

lines.en: : Don’t tease me.
lines.zh: : 别取笑我。

lines.en: : Even before my husband was drafted, it was like this- just with two bodies on the couch instead of one.
lines.zh: : 早在我丈夫被征召入伍之前，日子也是这样——只不过沙发上是两个人，而不是一个。

lines.en: : So you weren’t happy even when he was around?
lines.zh: : 所以他在的时候，你也不开心？

lines.en: scene harukaalone8
: I never said that.
lines.zh: : 我可没那么说。

lines.en: : When you love someone, you can do things like just sit on a couch with them and watch Gordon Ramsay yell at children and it will feel like the most fun you’ve had in forever.
lines.zh: : 当你爱着一个人，你就能跟他一起窝在沙发上，看戈登·拉姆齐冲小孩子大吼大叫，而那会是你这辈子最开心的时刻。

lines.en: : It isn’t until they’re gone that you realize how depressing it is to be watching TV alone.
lines.zh: : 直到他们走了，你才会意识到，一个人看电视有多让人沮丧。

lines.en: : This conversation got serious much quicker than I expected it to.
lines.zh: : 这话题转得比我预想的要沉重多了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone9
: Hahaha...yeah. Sorry about that. I’ve just...gotten so used to doing things like this with him that I find myself reliving those days any time I turn on Netflix.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……是啊。抱歉。我只是……太习惯跟他一起做这种事了，以至于每次打开 Netflix，我都会重温那些日子。

lines.en: : Which sounds kind of shitty to say since he’s still alive-
lines.zh: : 这话听着挺不是东西的，毕竟他还活着——

lines.en: Maybe.
lines.zh: 也许吧。

lines.en: : But...yeah. Let’s talk about something else. Like...
lines.zh: : 不过……算了。我们聊点别的吧。比如……

lines.en: scene harukaalone10
: Like, what’s it like being a[school] teacher?!
lines.zh: : 比如，在[school]当老师是什么感觉？！

lines.en: : That sounds like a lot more fun than what I do.
lines.zh: : 听起来比我干的有意思多了。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you’re apparently hot for [teenage]girls.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为你显然对 [teenage]女孩馋得很。

lines.en: : Yup. You got me.
lines.zh: : 对。被你猜中了。

lines.en: : Now tell me what it’s like.
lines.zh: : 快说说什么感觉。

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: How I feel about teaching...
lines.zh: 我对教书这件事的感受……

lines.en: : It kind of sucks.
lines.zh: : 挺烂的。

lines.en: scene harukaalone11
: That...is not the answer I expected.
lines.zh: : 这……可不是我期待的答案。

lines.en: : Why would you say that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会这么想？

lines.en: : With how much I’ve heard about you in[school] from Rin, I always kind of thought you liked your job.
lines.zh: : 我从 Rin 那儿听了那么多关于你在[school]的事，一直觉得你挺喜欢自己这份工作的。

lines.en: : You know, the whole touching youths thing.
lines.zh: : 就是那个……对年轻人动手动脚的事。

lines.en: : Just to clarify, which sort of “touching youths” are you referring to right now?
lines.zh: : 我确认一下，你现在说的是哪种“动手动脚”？

lines.en: scene harukaalone12
: The not-creepy one this time.
lines.zh: : 这次是那种不猥琐的。

lines.en: : Aren’t you interested in making differences in these girls lives or something like that?
lines.zh: : 你不是想给这些女孩的人生带来改变什么的吗？

lines.en: : How’d you get into teaching in the first place?
lines.zh: : 你最初是怎么当上老师的？

lines.en: : It just...kind of happened.
lines.zh: : 就是……顺其自然地发生了。

lines.en: : So you just kind of happened to go to[school] for years to become a teacher and then just kind of applied for a teaching job?
lines.zh: : 所以你是顺其自然地读了这么多年[school]，顺其自然地成了老师，然后又顺其自然地申请了教职？

lines.en: : No I mean it literally just kind of happened.
lines.zh: : 不，我的意思是字面意义上的顺其自然。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t get it.
lines.zh: : 你不会懂的。

lines.en: : Try me.
lines.zh: : 说说看。

lines.en: : It involves time travel.
lines.zh: : 这涉及时间旅行。

lines.en: scene harukaalone13
: Okay, never mind.
lines.zh: : 好了，当我没问。

lines.en: : It’s clear you’re not going to be serious, so we can just move on to something else.
lines.zh: : 显然你是不打算认真了，那我们就聊点别的吧。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 行吧。

lines.en: Can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: 至少我试过了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone14
: You know, I used to have a crush on my [high_school] teacher when I was around Rin’s age.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我在 Rin 这个年纪的时候，曾经暗恋过我的 [high_school] 老师。

lines.en: : Granted, I was too much of a coward to ever tell him that. And it’s not like I would have expected anything to have happened even if I did.
lines.zh: : 当然，我太怂了，从来没跟他说过。而且就算说了，我也不指望会发生什么。

lines.en: : Worried about the age gap thing?
lines.zh: : 担心年龄差的问题？

lines.en: : More like there just...wasn’t anything notable about me.
lines.zh: : 更像是……我身上根本没什么值得注意的地方。

lines.en: : I was just a normal girl living a normal life and studying just like any other normal person until, one day, I met the guy who I would end up marrying.
lines.zh: : 我就是个普通的女孩，过着普通的生活，像其他普通人一样念书，直到有一天，我遇见了那个我最后会嫁给的男人。

lines.en: : And suddenly we’re back at your husband.
lines.zh: : 然后话题突然又绕回你丈夫了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone15
: Fuck! Sorry. I didn’t mean to. It just keeps happening.
lines.zh: : 操！抱歉。我不是故意的。就是总会绕回去。

lines.en: : It’s fine. If it was that big of a deal, you wouldn’t keep inviting me over.
lines.zh: : 没事。如果这真那么要紧，你也不会一直叫我过来了。

lines.en: scene harukaalone16
: Yeah...You’re...probably right about that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你……大概说得对。

lines.en: : And besides, we’re just friends so...
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们只是朋友，所以……

lines.en: : It’s not like I love you or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我又不是爱你什么的。

lines.en: : You’re just...keeping me company.
lines.zh: : 你只是……在陪我而已。

lines.en: : That’s all.
lines.zh: : 就这样。

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
Haruka justifies her betrayal of a man who has not yet been confirmed dead in the only rational way she’s able to think up.
lines.zh: Haruka 用她唯一能想到的、还算合理的方式，为她对那个尚未确认死亡的男人的背叛开脱。

lines.en: She pretends the touch of my hands and the length of my cock are only temporary respites given to a woman in grief despite her unmeasurable levels of uncertainty.
lines.zh: 她假装我双手的触碰和我鸡巴的尺寸，不过是赐给一个悲伤女人的短暂慰藉——尽管她心里有着无法估量的动摇。

lines.en: I can see through her.
lines.zh: 我看得穿她。

lines.en: Anyone could if they’d just open their eyes.
lines.zh: 任何人只要睁开眼都看得出。

lines.en: She is horrible- just like me.
lines.zh: 她很烂——就跟我一样。

lines.en: We fit each other well.
lines.zh: 我们很般配。

lines.en: Physically and non-physically.
lines.zh: 不管是身体上，还是别的方面。

lines.en: She knows it too.
lines.zh: 她自己也知道。

lines.en: It’s one of the many reasons she continues to cry nearly every time we fuck.
lines.zh: 这也是每次我们做爱，她几乎都会哭的众多原因之一。

lines.en: else:
That’s right.
lines.zh: 没错。

lines.en: As it stands, all I am to Haruka is a friend.
lines.zh: 就目前而言，我对 Haruka 来说只是个朋友。

lines.en: Could I change that if I truly applied myself?
lines.zh: 要是我真下功夫，能改变这一点吗？

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概能。

lines.en: But would it be right to do so?
lines.zh: 可这么做是对的吗？

lines.en: Who knows?
lines.zh: 谁知道呢。

lines.en: It’s not really my place to say.
lines.zh: 轮不到我来下结论。

lines.en: If she thinks betrayal is the path that will make her feel whole, it’s a path she’s likely to take with or without me.
lines.zh: 如果她认为背叛是那条能让她感觉完整的路，那么不管有没有我，她都很可能走上去。

lines.en: All I can really do for the time being is continue to be near her.
lines.zh: 眼下我唯一能做的，就是继续待在她身边。

lines.en: To quell the unending loneliness of a woman unloved.
lines.zh: 去平息一个不被爱的女人那无止境的孤独。

lines.en: : Right. We’re just friends.
lines.zh: : 对。我们只是朋友。

lines.en: scene harukaalone17
: Exactly! Which is why it’s cool for us to do stuff like hang out on my couch and just...talk or...whatever it is we’re doing now.
lines.zh: : 就是这样！所以我们可以很自在地窝在我家沙发上，就……聊聊天，或者……随便我们现在在干什么。

lines.en: : Right.
: Now, your relationship with Maki on the other hand...
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，你和 Maki 的关系……

lines.en: scene harukaalone18
: Ugh. She’s so hot, though!
lines.zh: : 呃。可她真的好辣啊！

lines.en: : And he already signed off on that so it’s totally okay!
lines.zh: : 而且他早就签字同意了，所以完全没问题！

lines.en: : Besides, it really does only happen on rare occasions when we’re drunk.
lines.zh: : 再说了，真的只有我们喝醉的时候才会偶尔发生。

lines.en: : And you know firsthand what kind of wonders she can work with her tongue!
lines.zh: : 而且你可是亲身体验过，她的舌头能创造什么样的奇迹！

lines.en: : This is very true. That was most definitely not her first time.
lines.zh: : 这话一点不假。那绝对不是她的第一次。

lines.en: : Probably her millionth!
lines.zh: : 大概是一百万次了吧！

lines.en: : Okay now that just can’t even be possible.
lines.zh: : 好了，这可就不可能了。

lines.en: : Maki’s...a different type of animal compared to someone like me.
lines.zh: : Maki……跟我是完全不同的生物。

lines.en: : She’s like this crazy sex goddess and I’m some girl who was too scared to even touch herself until senior year of [high_school].
lines.zh: : 她简直就是个疯狂的性爱女神，而我呢，是个直到 [high_school] 最后一年都不敢碰自己的女孩。

lines.en: : I get nervous around her and just kind of...follow her lead.
lines.zh: : 我在她面前会紧张，就……只能跟着她的步调走。

lines.en: : Were you really that late of a bloomer?
lines.zh: : 你开窍得真有那么晚？

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
scene harukaalone19
: I’ve only ever been with two guys before...
lines.zh: : 我以前只跟两个男人在一起过……

lines.en: : That includes kissing, too.
lines.zh: : 接吻也算上。

lines.en: : Well, not counting girls.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不算女孩的话。

lines.en: else:
scene harukaalone19
: My husband is the only guy I’ve ever been with...
lines.zh: : 我丈夫是我唯一相处过的男人……

lines.en: : I’ve never even kissed anyone else.
lines.zh: : 我甚至没跟别人接过吻。

lines.en: : Well, not counting girls.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不算女孩的话。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, the amount of girls you kiss makes no difference to me.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点——你亲过多少女孩，对我来说毫无差别。

lines.en: : Feel free to shoot for the world record if you want.
lines.zh: : 想去冲世界纪录也随便你。

lines.en: : I will support you every step of the way.
lines.zh: : 我会一路支持你。

lines.en: scene harukaalone20
: Even when I start coming for all of the girls in your class?
lines.zh: : 就算我开始对你班上所有女孩下手也一样？

lines.en: : Start with Rin. I frequently worry that she’ll explode if she doesn’t find an outlet for her pent-up lesbian energy soon.
lines.zh: : 那就从 Rin 开始。我经常担心，她要是再找不到出口发泄那股憋着的百合能量，会直接爆炸。

lines.en: : How about we share her?
lines.zh: : 要不我们共享她？

lines.en: : Deal. Sign me up.
lines.zh: : 成交。算我一个。

lines.en: scene harukaalone21
: I’m gonna tell her you said that~
lines.zh: : 我要去跟她说这是你说的哦~

lines.en: : Fine by me.
lines.zh: : 随你便。

lines.en: : Also, what is the meaning of this?
lines.zh: : 另外，这算怎么回事？

lines.en: : I don’t have Rin’s number yet and I feel like I’m much closer to her than you are.
lines.zh: : 我到现在还没有 Rin 的电话号码，可我觉得我跟她的关系比你近多了。

lines.en: : She works for me, dude. I need her number to send her pictures of the schedule.
lines.zh: : 她在我这儿打工啊，老兄。我得有她号码，好把排班表的照片发给她。

lines.en: : Do you want it?
lines.zh: : 你想要吗？

lines.en: : I hope you mean her number and not a picture of the schedule.
lines.zh: : 我希望你说的是她的号码，而不是排班表的照片。

lines.en: : What, so you don’t want to come work for me?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你是不想来我这儿打工吗？

lines.en: : I can’t say I do.
lines.zh: : 我确实不想。

lines.en: : I’ll accept a phone number, though.
lines.zh: : 不过电话号码我可以收下。

lines.en: : Fine. Here.
lines.zh: : 行。给你。

lines.en: Haruka begins listing the digits of Rin’s phone number and I carefully type them into my phone.
lines.zh: Haruka 开始一个一个报出 Rin 的电话号码，我小心翼翼地把它输进手机。

lines.en: $ rinnumber = True
Congratulations! You have received Rin’s phone number in an extremely roundabout way!
lines.zh: 恭喜！你以一种极其迂回的方式获得了 Rin 的电话号码！

lines.en: You can now call her to hang out on afternoons, but she will likely be confused when she realizes she never personally gave you her number!
lines.zh: 现在你可以在下午打电话约她出来玩了，不过等她意识到自己从来没有亲自把号码给过你时，她大概会一头雾水！

lines.en: : This is a big victory for me.
lines.zh: : 这对我来说是一场重大胜利。

lines.en: scene harukaalone22
: Well I’m sorry to be the bearer of bad news but I’ve got a big loss for you coming up next.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉我要当个坏消息的信使了——不过接下来等着你的是一场重大失利。

lines.en: : What? What happened?
lines.zh: : 什么？出什么事了？

lines.en: : So when I told Rin just now that we were talking about sharing her-
lines.zh: : 是这样，我刚才跟 Rin 说我们在讨论共享她的事——

lines.en: : You actually told her that? I thought you were kidding.
lines.zh: : 你还真跟她说了？我以为你在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Well, what I really said was, “Would you date your teacher?”
lines.zh: : 其实我原话是：“你会跟你老师约会吗？”

lines.en: : Why? You completely removed yourself from the equation and this was entirely your idea.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你把自己完全从等式里摘出去了，这明明是你的主意。

lines.en: : I’m testing the waters. Just be happy I gave you her number.
lines.zh: : 我这是在试探水温。我把她号码都给你了，知足吧。

lines.en: : Haruka, what the fuck?
lines.zh: : Haruka，你到底在搞什么鬼？

lines.en: : Well anyway, all she texted back was the upside down smile emoji.
lines.zh: : 总之，她回的就只有那个倒过来的笑脸表情。

lines.en: : That could mean anything.
lines.zh: : 那可以代表任何意思。

lines.en: : Mmm...I think in this case it means “I’d rather date you, Haruka. You’re so pretty and your boobs are great.”
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得在这种情况下，它的意思是“我更想跟你约会，Haruka。你那么漂亮，胸还那么棒。”

lines.en: : You sound like a grown-up version of my [niece].
lines.zh: : 你说话的口气，活像我 [niece] 的成年版本。

lines.en: scene harukaalone23
: Wanna give me her number in exchange for Rin’s?
lines.zh: : 那你要不要把她号码给我，换 Rin 的？

lines.en: : I don’t think she’s your type. And also no.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她不是你的菜。而且不行。

lines.en: scene harukaalone24
: Fine. Looks like I’ll just have to send Rin a wink emoji and forever ruin your chances of romancing her.
lines.zh: : 行吧。看来我只能给 Rin 发个眨眼表情，然后彻底毁掉你追她的机会了。

lines.en: : I’ve been around these girls long enough to know how they operate and-
lines.zh: : 我在这群女孩身边待得够久，清楚她们的行事方式，而且——

lines.en: scene harukaalone25
: Woah!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！

lines.en: : Woah what? What happened?
lines.zh: : 哇哦什么？怎么了？

lines.en: : Did Rin say something else?
lines.zh: : Rin 又说了什么？

lines.en: scene harukaalone26
: No, but Molly did.
lines.zh: : 不是，是 Molly 说了。

lines.en: : You texted her too?
lines.zh: : 你也给她发短信了？

lines.en: : It was a group text with the two of them.
lines.zh: : 那是个群发，她们俩都在里面。

lines.en: : You didn’t even do it privately?...
lines.zh: : 你连私聊都没用？……

lines.en: : What did Molly say?
lines.zh: : Molly 说了什么？

lines.en: : Six eggplant emojis and then water droplets.
lines.zh: : 六个茄子表情，然后是几滴水珠。

lines.en: : Is that good? That sounds good.
lines.zh: : 这是好事吗？听着像好事。

lines.en: : Too good. You should be worried.
lines.zh: : 好过头了。你该担心了。

lines.en: : Well, at least I went one for two.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少两中一。

lines.en: : You’re gonna tell me if anything happens, right?
lines.zh: : 要是真发生了什么，你会告诉我的吧？

lines.en: scene black
: Probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。

lines.en: : And you call yourself my friend...
lines.zh: : 你还自称是我朋友呢……

lines.en: Haruka and I hang out for a while longer and she continues to lecture me on the meanings of different emojis.
lines.zh: 我和 Haruka 又待了一会儿，她继续给我上课，讲各种表情符号的含义。

lines.en: I immediately forget all of them because it is a stupid conversation topic and I honestly just don’t care.
lines.zh: 我转头就全忘了，因为这话题蠢透了，而且我是真的一点都不在乎。

lines.en: Eventually, I wind up walking home-
lines.zh: 最后，我还是走上了回家的路——

lines.en: And once again thinking about how nice it would be to memorize these streets.
lines.zh: 又一次在想，要是能把这些街道都记下来，该有多好。

lines.en: $ harukadate15 = True
$ haruka_love += 1
Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!
lines.zh: Haruka 的好感度提升到了 [haruka_love]！
